statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The clinical indication note describes symptoms as clinically consistent with underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment
The service was to evaluate the correlation between symptoms and potential arrhythmic events
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is missing prior authorization
The diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, R42
